gateway.seoTitle: Safe and Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence
gateway.seoDescription: SafeAI613 — an open-source community for safe use of AI: knowledge and community in SafeAI Hub, and a filtered API service in SafeAI Platform.

hero.lead: SafeAI613 builds open-source infrastructure for safe and responsible use of AI — knowledge and community in the Hub, and a filtered API service in the Platform. All aligned with the values of the Torah-observant community.

hub.lead: A knowledge and community center: how to work with artificial intelligence properly, what is worthwhile and what is not, and how to integrate it into professional work without compromising on values — including guidance from a Haredi perspective on using these tools.

platform.lead: An API gateway that connects to the tools and applications you already use — get a key, change the URL, and everything else happens along the way.

points.compatible: An API compatible with the common formats — change the URL and keep working
points.filtered: Every request and every response is filtered along the way
points.profiles: Filter profiles per organization and per professional domain
points.keys: Bring your own key (BYOK) or use managed keys, with usage and budget tracking

platform.terminalCaption: Demo: an API call that passes input and output filtering

why.lead: AI tools have entered every professional field, and using them is already unavoidable. But a language model can also hold a conversation, offer compliments, give advice and go on and on. We do not accept this change with indifference — we are preparing for it.

professional.title: Professional use only
professional.text: AI for solving focused tasks — not as a “person” to chat with about any topic.

core.title: Core filtering
core.text: Blocking forbidden content entirely, in both the question and the answer, before it reaches the user.

domain.title: Domain filtering
domain.text: Defining a professional domain for each system, so the conversation stays focused on the purpose it was built for.

contact.lead: For users, developers, institutions and organizations. Tell us what you need — and together we will find the right way forward.

support.title: Questions or technical support
support.description: Write to us and we will get back to you soon

devTeam.title: Join the development team
devTeam.description: An open-source community looking for skilled hands

organizations.title: Organizations and institutions
organizations.description: Open an organization account with tailored filtering

hubIntro.seoDescription: A knowledge and community center for safe and thoughtful use of artificial intelligence: news, forum, articles, courses and guides — within the right boundaries.

news.title: AI News
news.description: What is new in the world of tools — concise, in clean language and without noise.

forum.title: Forum
forum.description: Ask, answer and share practical experience with a community that shares the same values.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: In-depth explanations: how AI tools work, and how to use them properly and safely.

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: Structured learning, step by step — from the basics to integrating AI into professional work.

guides.title: Recommended Guides
guides.description: Carefully selected guides that save you from searching in unsuitable places.

projects.title: Project Board
projects.description: Projects open to the community — a place to contribute, learn and gain hands-on experience with a real product.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: AI agents built by the community for focused tasks, ready to use.

tool.title: AI as a work tool
tool.text: Learning to operate the tool for a defined task — not to hold an open conversation with it about any topic.

boundaries.title: Knowledge with boundaries
boundaries.text: The content is written and selected from the worldview of the Torah-observant community: what is suitable, what is not, and how to stay careful.

community.title: A values-driven community
community.text: A place to consult and share experience with people seeking the same balance — professionalism without compromise.

stats.label: SafeAI Hub in numbers

hero.lead: A knowledge and community center for safe and thoughtful use of artificial intelligence. News, articles, courses and guides — with an emphasis on professional, focused use, aligned with the worldview of the Torah-observant community.

areasSection.lead: Each area opens the door to a different field. Reading is open to everyone; to post, comment or submit — log in.

cta.lead: Reading is open to everyone — come in, choose an area, and start learning.

platformIntro.seoDescription: An API gateway for language models with built-in input and output filtering, key management, usage tracking and organization accounts.

register.title: Sign up
register.text: Open a personal or organization account in a few minutes.

createKey.title: Create an API key
createKey.text: A personal key that identifies you and your filter profile.

switchUrl.title: Change the URL
switchUrl.text: Point your existing code or tool to the SafeAI address.

work.title: Work with peace of mind
work.text: Every request and every response is filtered — automatically.

profiles.title: Filter profiles
profiles.text: Core filtering that blocks forbidden content, and domain filtering that keeps the system focused on its purpose. Each organization chooses the profiles that suit it.

keys.title: Key management
keys.text: Create, revoke and track — all in one place.

usage.title: Usage tracking
usage.text: Requests and tokens per day, with clear charts.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.text: Users, budget and invoices for each organization.

byok.title: BYOK or managed
byok.text: Bring your own provider key, or use the system's keys.

compat.title: Developer tool compatibility

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.text: All the code is open and transparent — you can review it, learn from it and contribute.
